doc.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998

title: Upcoming plans and goodbyes
summary: Tampa Florida Orchestra plans, birthday congratulations and thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Wow. Where are you off to — tomorrow you’re back to New York?

Back to New York. I have a heavy week in New York and then I go down to, I have an orchestra in Tampa — I don’t have it, I’m music director of a series in Tampa which, it’s called something very original, the Florida Orchestra, but I’ve been there about thirteen years and we play Tampa, St. Petersburg and Clearwater and the cities on the west coast. It’s quite a good orchestra. And I’m looking forward to the next program because we’re doing a program based on the music of South and Central America and we may even, I say the word hesitantly, we may try to experiment with them playing some Bossa Nova.
Can I guess that Bob Rosengarden will be there to help with that?
Always. Yes. He’s the time salesman.
Well this has really been an extreme pleasure for me.

Well it’s a pleasure for me, thank you, I’m glad that I got here continuing the commute, what is it, an 1800 mile commute, that’s a pretty good commute. One nighters used to be a hundred miles, but now—
Well this was a miserable airplane. So thank you.
Well congratulations on your 80th birthday and your 40 years with Ruth, is that right?
And everything else that goes with it.
